name: MCP73831
description: MCP73831 リチウムイオン電池 1セル リニア充電IC (SOT-23-5, ピン1=STAT 2=VSS 3=VBAT 4=VDD 5=PROG)。充電電流 = 1000 ÷ R_PROG[Ω] [A] (2kΩで500mA)。プリチャージ→定電流→4.2Vの定電圧の動作を再現する動作モデル(出力電圧 4.2V 品)。STAT は充電中だけ Low になるオープンドレインとして扱います(実物の High/Hi-Z の区別は無し)。熱制限・タイマは扱いません。数値は概算

sim.name: MCP73831
sim.text:
.subckt MCP73831 stat vss vbat vdd prog
* MCP73831 behavioural model
* Linear Li-ion charger as a behavioural model: pre-charge, constant current, constant voltage.
* Control signals are scaled so that 1 V = 1 A. Amplifiers and "the smaller one wins" selectors are
* made of controlled sources and switches, as in the NE555 model.
Vref1 r1 vss DC 1.0
Vref0 r0 vss DC 0.1
V29 v29 vss DC 2.8
V37 v37 vss DC 3.75
V40 v40 vss DC 4.0
V15 v15 vss DC 1.5
V01 v01 vss DC 0.1
Vreg vreg vss DC 4.2
* PROG reference: 1 V for constant current, 0.1 V while the cell is deeply discharged
Rrf rf vss 1k
Sr1 r1 rf vbat v29 SWC
Sr0 r0 rf v29 vbat SWC
* error amplifiers: current loop (PROG held at the reference) and voltage loop (cell voltage)
Ea ea vss rf prog 1000
Eb eb vss vreg vbat 20
* the smaller one wins
Rm m vss 1k
Sma ea m eb ea SWC
Smb eb m ea eb SWC
* only positive, only when VCC is high enough, above the cell and enabled
Sx m n1 m vss SWC
Sg1 n1 n2 vdd bo SWC
Sg2 n2 n3 vdd v37 SWC
Rg3 n3 u 1m
Rl u vss 1k
Rn1 n1 vss 1Meg
Rn2 n2 vss 1Meg
Rn3 n3 vss 1Meg
Vbo bo vbat DC 0.3
* pass element: the charge current, and its image (1000x smaller) out of PROG
Gb vdd vbat u vss 1
Gp vss prog u vss 0.001
* status (open drain): low while charging (PROG above 0.1 V or the cell not yet full)
Sc1 stat c1 prog v01 SWO
Sc2 c1 vss vdd v37 SWO
Sc3 stat c2 v40 vbat SWO
Sc4 c2 vss vdd v37 SWO
Rc1 c1 vss 100Meg
Rc2 c2 vss 100Meg
Riq vdd vss 20k

.model SWC SW(RON=1 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.005)
.model SWO SW(RON=60 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.005)

.ends MCP73831
